label: 精密激光加工设备
definition: Delphi FY2025 source product basket for whole precision laser-processing equipment. Includes semiconductor, consumer/automotive electronics, new energy and display applications; excludes separately reported lasers, processing services and component processing/repair. The p38 financial product row and physical production/sales/inventory row share the source-native basket label, but no model-specific, dicing-only or semiconductor-only allocation is justified. Unit sales are not installed systems.

label: 报告期末母公司和主要子公司在职员工
definition: FY2025 report workforce table population: active employees of Delphi Laser parent and major subsidiaries at reporting year-end, all businesses. Not asserted to include every consolidated subsidiary.

label: Delphi Laser in-progress project: SDBG laser stealth-dicing process improvement
definition: Row 12 of the 在研项目情况 table in the FY2025 annual report: SDBG 激光隐切工艺提升研发项目, stage 研发中. The filing glosses SDBG as 研磨前隐切 (stealth dicing before grinding) and gives the application as 应用在存储芯片的 SDBG（研磨前隐切）工艺制程 plus 其它材料（如：磷化铟，碳化硅，硅，玻璃等）的隐切制程. Wafer-internal laser modification for die singulation, i.e. laser/stealth dicing. Scope is this one R&D project, not a product revenue line.

label: Delphi Laser in-progress project: compound-material laser stealth-dicing process research
definition: Row 16 of the 在研项目情况 table in the FY2025 annual report: 化合物材料激光隐切工艺研究, stage 研发中. Stated application 第三代半导体晶圆加工 SiC、GaN 激光隐切/内部改质, stated problem 小尺寸 DIE 顶不起、崩边、良率低, stated compatibility 兼容 6/8 寸、大小尺寸 DIE、不同厚度晶圆. Die singulation of compound-semiconductor wafers by internal laser modification. The filing places the work at 实验室测试结束向中试/小规模客户现场量产过渡, so nothing here is a shipped-product specification.

label: Delphi Laser semiconductor-related laser processing equipment, FY2025 narrative revenue line
definition: Issuer's own 半导体相关激光加工设备 revenue line (FY2025 annual report p18), a narrative split of the 精密激光加工设备 product line that the 分产品 table does not carry. The basket is MULTI-PROCESS: the issuer's semiconductor product list (p12) contains 激光划片, 晶圆激光开槽, 碳化硅晶锭切片, 碳化硅激光退火, 晶圆激光隐切设备（SDBG）, 玻璃通孔（TGV）, 激光开槽（low-k）, Edge Trimming, 晶圆打标, 模组钻孔（TMV）, 激光解键合（debonding） and 辅助焊接. It therefore mixes dicing with annealing, drilling, marking and debonding and must not be read as dicing revenue. It is a component of the wider delphi_precision_laser_processing_equipment_all_sectors line and is not additive with it.

label: Delphi Laser silicon-wafer laser stealth-dicing equipment, FY2025 narrative description
definition: Source-native 硅晶圆激光隐切设备 as described in the FY2025 annual report p16: 该设备针对 12 英寸硅存储芯片研发，全面支持 SDAG（Stealth Dicing After Grinding）与 SDBG 工艺，特别适用于厚度 35～85μm 的超薄晶圆隐切与减薄前加工. Silicon memory-wafer stealth dicing, both after-grinding and before-grinding process routes. Kept separate from the named model LSD-6130 (delphi_lsd_6130 platform, p19) because the existing verified platform record states p16 describes the broader silicon stealth-dicing equipment and only p19 pins order validation and market sale to that model. The 首个国产量产订单 from a leading domestic memory maker on this page prints no digit, customer name or amount and is not recorded as a quantity.
